ambient_events: The hose drips into the drain, patient and steady.
A row of chalked lockers holds other people's tablets, all of them dark, all of them staying that way.
Someone has written above the mirror, in a careful hand: THE MACHINE KNOWS YOU BY WHAT YOU CARRY.
description: A tiled scrub room with a run of hooks, a drain, and a hose fed from somewhere upstream. This is where you leave everything that can be listened to: tablets, chips, anything with a cell in it goes into a lead-lined locker with your name chalked on it, and the sewer goes down the drain with the rest. There is a mirror bolted at eye height, and beside it a set of calipers and a probe, because the Watch check for chrome and they do not take your word for it.
name: The Wash
